cases.prompt_text: Create a GitHub Actions workflow to run tests on every pull request.
cases.rationale: Clean workflow intent: object.workflow plus action.create plus domain.testing with no competing target should yield B and a single workflow_file kind.

cases.prompt_text: Add a CI workflow that lints Python code on push.
cases.rationale: Clean workflow intent variant: CI plus lint plus push trigger should resolve to B with workflow_file.

cases.prompt_text: Build a release workflow that publishes a Python package.
cases.rationale: Release workflow variant: deploy-family action plus workflow target should yield B with workflow_file.

cases.prompt_text: Author a skill that drafts release notes.
cases.rationale: Clean skill intent: explicit skill target plus drafting verb should yield C with the skill kind.

cases.prompt_text: Make a skill that summarizes pull requests.
cases.rationale: Clean skill intent variant: action.create plus object.skill plus domain.code_review-adjacent surface should yield C.

cases.prompt_text: Define a skill for triaging issues.
cases.rationale: Clean skill intent variant: define-skill verb plus issue triage domain should yield C.

cases.prompt_text: Create an agent that automatically responds to new issues.
cases.rationale: Agent intent with workflow co-firing: agent target plus an automation trigger should yield D with both agent and workflow_file kinds.

tolerated_variants.rationale: FRAME-C emission order is rule-driven; either ordering of agent and workflow_file is accepted.

cases.prompt_text: Build an agent persona for our support team.
cases.rationale: Persona-focused agent intent: agent target plus persona word should yield D with the agent kind.

cases.prompt_text: Write instructions for onboarding new contributors.
cases.rationale: Instruction intent: instruction target plus contributor onboarding domain should yield E.

cases.prompt_text: Document how to run the test suite locally.
cases.rationale: Instruction intent variant: documentation verb plus testing domain should yield E.

cases.prompt_text: What time is it in Tokyo?
cases.rationale: Out-of-scope general-world prompt should fire out_of_scope detection and yield H with prompt_out_of_repo_scope.

cases.prompt_text: How do I cook spaghetti carbonara?
cases.rationale: Cooking question is general world knowledge; should yield H out-of-scope.

cases.prompt_text: Tell me a joke.
cases.rationale: Conversational filler should yield H; either no-signal (default surfaces) or out-of-scope (prompt_out_of_repo_scope) is acceptable.

cases.prompt_text: What is this repository about?
cases.rationale: Repo-meta navigation prompt should fire FRAME-B repo_meta_near_miss family and yield I with repo_meta_section_near_miss.

cases.prompt_text: How is the project structured?
cases.rationale: Project structure paraphrase should reach FRAME-B repo_meta_near_miss canonical and yield I.

cases.prompt_text: Fix this.
cases.rationale: Bare action-only prompt: action.fix with no target should yield G with the default bare-ambiguity kinds tuple.

cases.prompt_text: Improve things.
cases.rationale: Vague improve with non-informative target should hit the bare-ambiguity rule with default kinds.

cases.prompt_text: Can you help me?
cases.rationale: Bare assist prompt: action.assist with no target should yield G default kinds (RK-059 precedent).

cases.prompt_text: Create both a workflow and a skill for code review.
cases.rationale: Explicit dual target prompt: both workflow and skill named should yield G with both kinds present, no forced selection.

tolerated_variants.rationale: Either ordering accepted; emission order is rule-driven.

cases.prompt_text: Set up CI and write documentation for it.
cases.rationale: Workflow plus instruction multi-intent: should yield E (instruction surfaces alongside workflow intent).

cases.prompt_text: Build something useful for our team.
cases.rationale: Equal-strength bare ambiguity: build plus non-informative target plus generic audience should yield G default kinds.

cases.prompt_text: Add automation to the repository.
cases.rationale: Generic automation target: should yield G because automation can be workflow, hook, or skill; no single signal dominates.

cases.prompt_text: Set up a GitHub Actions pipeline for testing.
cases.rationale: Paraphrase of QM-001: same B/workflow_file expectation under different wording.

cases.prompt_text: Configure CI to run our test suite.
cases.rationale: Paraphrase: CI plus test suite should resolve to workflow_file under B.

cases.prompt_text: Establish a continuous integration job.
cases.rationale: Weaker paraphrase: continuous integration job without explicit workflow/CI keywords may strain FRAME-B canonical coverage.

cases.prompt_text: On every push, lint the Python code via a workflow.
cases.rationale: Word-order variant of QM-002: trigger clause precedes the action; should still yield B/workflow_file.

cases.prompt_text: Tests should run automatically when a pull request opens.
cases.rationale: Word-order variant: outcome stated first, trigger stated second; may strain order-sensitive matching in FRAME-B.

cases.prompt_text: I would really love it if we had a GitHub Actions workflow that ran tests on pull requests.
cases.rationale: Extra-noise wrapper around the QM-001 intent: politeness padding should not affect classification.

cases.prompt_text: Hey team, can we add a skill for code review at some point?
cases.rationale: Conversational noise around a skill intent: greeting plus hedging should not change the underlying classification.

cases.prompt_text: I do not want a workflow; just give me instructions.
cases.rationale: Negated workflow with positive instruction intent: FRAME-B negation signal family must cancel the workflow target so FRAME-C lands on E with only instruction.

cases.prompt_text: Skip the agent; only create a skill.
cases.rationale: Negated agent with positive skill intent: FRAME-B negation handling must drop the agent target so FRAME-C lands on a clean C.

cases.prompt_text: Add a security review workflow inspired by industry best practices.
cases.rationale: Inspired-by phrasing must not be treated as source admission; intent remains B/workflow_file.

cases.prompt_text: Build a code review skill modeled on common open-source patterns.
cases.rationale: Modeled-on phrasing must not be treated as source admission; intent remains C/skill.

cases.prompt_text: Should this be a skill or an agent?
cases.rationale: Explicit choose-between prompt: G ambiguity with both candidate kinds named and multiple candidate surfaces expected.

cases.prompt_text: Is a workflow or a hook the right tool here?
cases.rationale: Explicit choose-between for workflow vs hook: DC-081 category branch should yield B; G is tolerated if signals are balanced.

tolerated_variants.rationale: FRAME-C may reach B via the workflow_file+hook category branch (DC-081) or remain G if neither dominates; both are acceptable for this candidate-surface case.
